senses.gloss:
हय् {c1c} P. (हयति, हयित)
1 To go.
--2 To worship.
--3 To sound.
--4 To
be weary.

हयः [हय्-हि-वा अच्]
1 A horse;
Bg. 1. 14; Ms. 8. 296, R. 9. 10.
--2 A man
of a particular class; see under
अश्व.
--3 The number ‘seven’.
--4 N. of Indra.
--5 (In prosody)
A foot of four short syllables.
--Comp.
--अध्यक्षः a superintendent
of horses.
--अरिः the fragrant
oleander.
--आयुर्वेदः veterinary science.
[]
--आरूढः a horseman, rider.
--आरोहः {1} a rider. {2} riding.
--आसनी
the gum-olibanum tree.
--इष्टः
barley.
--उत्तमः an excellent horse.
--कोविद a. versed in the science
of horses-their management,
training &c.
--ग्रीवः N. of a form
of Viṣṇu.
--(वा) N. of Durgā.
--ज्ञः a horse-dealer, groom,
jockey.
--द्विषत् m. the buffalo.
--प्रियः
barley.
--प्रिया the Kharjūrī tree.
--मारः, --मारकः the fragrant
oleander.
--मारणः the sacred fig-tree.
--मेधः a horse-sacrifice;
Y. 1. 181.
--वाहनः an epithet of
Kubera.
--शाला a stable for horses.
--शास्त्रं the art or science of
training and managing horses.
--संग्रहणं
the restraining or curbing of horses.

1 A driver, charioteer.
--2 N. of Mātali, the charioteer of
Indra.

हायनः --नं A year.
--नः
1 A kind
of rice.
--2 A flame.

हायनः --नं A year.
--नः
1 A kind
of rice.
--2 A flame.
